name: Kegasareta Miko Shouzoku ~Nakadashi Houjou Hakudakusai~
original_name: 穢された巫女装束～中出し豊穣白濁祭
source:
Deep in the mountains there is an isolated village. Shrime maiden is sent by father priest for the shrine in the depths of the forest to participate in fertility festival. Younger sister runs after the girl and gets abducted on the way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
偏远深山里坐落着一座与世隔绝的村庄。父亲身为神主，派巫女前往森林深处的神社参加丰穰祭。妹妹追在她身后，却在途中遭人掳走。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vndb-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
